import re

def parse(lines):
    fmt_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<file>\S.*?):\s+file format\s+(?P<format>\S+)\s*$')
    sec_re = re.compile(r'^Disassembly of section\s+(?P<section>\S+?):\s*$')
    sym_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<address>[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+<(?P<symbol>.+)>:\s*$')
    ins_re = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<offset>[0-9a-fA-F]+):\t(?P<rest>.*)$')
    info = {}
    info_lines = []
    secs = []
    sec_lines = []
    funcs = []
    func_lines = []
    insns = []
    insn_lines = []
    skip = []
    section = ''
    func = ''
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = fmt_re.match(line)
        if m:
            info['file'] = m.group('file')
            info['file format'] = m.group('format')
            info_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = sec_re.match(line)
        if m:
            section = m.group('section')
            func = ''
            secs.append({'section': section})
            sec_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = sym_re.match(line)
        if m:
            func = m.group('symbol')
            funcs.append({'section': section, 'address': m.group('address'), 'symbol': func})
            func_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = ins_re.match(line)
        if m:
            parts = m.group('rest').split('\t')
            raw = ''
            text = ''
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                raw = parts[0].strip()
                text = '\t'.join(parts[1:]).strip()
            else:
                p = parts[0].strip()
                if re.match(r'^(?:[0-9a-f]{2}\s?)+$', p):
                    raw = p
                else:
                    text = p
            mn = ''
            ops = ''
            if text:
                bits = text.split(None, 1)
                mn = bits[0]
                ops = bits[1].strip() if len(bits) > 1 else ''
            insns.append({'section': section, 'function': func, 'offset': m.group('offset'), 'bytes': raw, 'mnemonic': mn, 'operands': ops})
            insn_lines.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if info:
        blocks.append({'name': 'file', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': info_lines, 'records': [info]})
    if secs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'sections', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': sec_lines, 'records': secs})
    if funcs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'functions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': func_lines, 'records': funcs})
    if insns:
        blocks.append({'name': 'instructions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': insn_lines, 'records': insns})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
